# Ivan de Murard

> Product builder based in Paris. Five years across start-ups, scale-ups and large groups, plus two years co-founding Sonor (B2G SaaS). Designs from operational experience, ships with AI, keeps the human at the center. Focus areas: agentic AI, boutique hotel operations, service design, SaaS, open data.

- Site: https://www.ivandemurard.com

## Case studies

- [Aetherix](https://www.ivandemurard.com/atherix): Agentic AI framework for boutique hotel operations. Anticipates staffing and F&B needs in real time, reduces food waste and operational costs, frees teams to focus on guest experience. Stack: Apaleo PMS, FastAPI, Claude Sonnet, Qdrant, pgvector, MCP.
- [Sonor](https://www.ivandemurard.com/sonor): Two-year journey as Co-founder & Product Lead. Turned open data into a B2G SaaS used by municipalities to map urban noise and drive sustainability policy.
- [Tacet](https://www.ivandemurard.com/tacet): Mobile-first app that puts real-time Bruitparif data and a Serenity Score in Parisians' hands to reclaim quiet in housing and commutes.

## Track record

- 2024 to 2025, Product Manager at FORTIL for DomusVi: rolled out an internal SaaS to 500+ users across 100 care homes.
- 2023 to 2024, Product Manager at ALTEN for Bouygues Telecom: data-driven dashboard recovered 40% of 1.9M EUR receivables.
- 2022 to 2023, Customer Success Manager at Opendatasoft: 22 European city and metropolitan clients, 2 launches, zero churn.
- 2020 to 2022, Co-founder & Product Manager at Sonor: 0 to 1 B2G SaaS, backed by Matrice and Banque des Territoires, 20K EUR in grants.
